findings.evidence: AccessMethods.lean:219-222 `x := (electronMethod g k p kPrime).Q2 / (2 * g p k * SigmaMethodData.ySigma ⟨pX, kPrime, p⟩ g); Q2 := (electronMethod g k p kPrime).Q2; y := SigmaMethodData.ySigma ⟨pX, kPrime, p⟩ g` vs 229-232 `x := (electronMethod g k p kPrime).Q2 / (2 * g p (pX - p)); Q2 := (electronMethod g k p kPrime).Q2; y := (hadronicMethod g k p pX).y`; AccessMethods.lean:250-254 and 188-190 are the same two-rewrite proof `mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpk`.
findings.fix: Add one shared constructor next to `ofTransfer`, e.g. `@[simps] def ReconstructedInvariants.ofQ2AndY (g : Bilin V) (k p : V) (Q2 y : ℝ) : ReconstructedInvariants := ⟨Q2 / (2 * g p k * y), Q2, y⟩`, and define `sigmaMethod g k p kPrime pX := .ofQ2AndY g k p (electronMethod g k p kPrime).Q2 (SigmaMethodData.ySigma ⟨pX, kPrime, p⟩ g)` and `mixedMethod g k p kPrime pX := .ofQ2AndY g k p (electronMethod g k p kPrime).Q2 (hadronicMethod g k p pX).y`. `mixedMethod_x_eq` then becomes the generated `ofQ2AndY_x`, and `ofTransfer_x_eq` becomes the single statement `ofTransfer g k p q = ofQ2AndY g k p (ofTransfer g k p q).Q2 (ofTransfer g k p q).y` under `hpk`. Note the only behavioural change is `mixedMethod.x`'s junk value at `g p k = 0`, which `mixedMethod_x_eq` already shows is the sole point of disagreement.
findings.issue: `sigmaMethod` (219-222) and `mixedMethod` (229-232) are the same construction instantiated at two different inelasticities: both take `Q2 := (electronMethod g k p kPrime).Q2` and both set `x` to `Q²_e / (2 (p·k) y)` — sigma writes it literally, mixed writes the cancelled form `Q²_e / (2 * g p (pX - p))`, and `mixedMethod_x_eq` (250-254) is precisely the proof that the two forms agree when `g p k ≠ 0`. `ReconstructedInvariants.ofTransfer_x_eq` (188-190) states the same `x = Q²/(2 (p·k) y)` relation a third time, with the identical proof `mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpk`, and has no consumer in the repo.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn 'shiftXQ2_toReconstructedInvariants_self|shiftXY_toReconstructedInvariants_self' code/` returns only AccessMethods.lean:328 and :333; both proof bodies are the single tactic `simp`.
findings.fix: Delete both; callers that need the fact get it from `simp` or from `shiftXQ2_eq_zero_iff.2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩`.
findings.issue: `shiftXQ2_toReconstructedInvariants_self` (328-330) and `shiftXY_toReconstructedInvariants_self` (333-335) are each proved by `simp` alone, i.e. entirely by the `@[simp]` lemmas `shiftXQ2_eq_zero_iff` (318) and `shiftXY_eq_zero_iff` (323) together with the `@[simps]` projections of `toReconstructedInvariants`. They add two public names for what the preceding simp lemmas already give and have no consumer: grep over `code/` finds them only at their own declaration sites.

summary: The prior electron/hadronic duplication is resolved via ReconstructedInvariants.ofTransfer, but sigmaMethod and mixedMethod are still the same construction written twice (electron Q², a hadronic y, x = Q²_e/(2 (p·k) y)), and two shift corollaries are reproved by simp from the @[simp] iff lemmas and never used.
